integrity.proof_status: elementary proof of exact families and complete exchange list
integrity.unproved_claims: No extension to other congruence classes or generalized Petersen parameters; no independent scholarly review.

limitations: Infinite-family theorem restricted to lengths congruent to 0 or 4 modulo 5 and ordinary one-for-one token exchange.
Finite scripts independently verify representative lengths and all templates up to length 99; they do not certify the infinite theorem.
Possible unpublished, differently titled or inaccessible historical work on optimal vertex-cover exchange graphs may overlap.
title: A single period-five defect makes optimal independent sets of generalized Petersen graphs form one cycle
